segments.sn10.11:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
segments.sn10.11:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena aññataro upāsako cīrāya [cirāya (ka.)] bhikkhuniyā cīvaraṃ adāsi.
segments.sn10.11:1.4: Atha kho cīrāya bhikkhuniyā abhippasanno yakkho rājagahe rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi –
segments.sn10.11:2.1: “Puññaṃ vata pasavi bahuṃ, sappañño vatāyaṃ upāsako;
segments.sn10.11:2.3: Yo cīrāya adāsi cīvaraṃ, sabbayogehi vippamuttiyā”ti [vippamuttāyāti (syā. kaṃ.)].

lines: Tattha hi bhojanaṃ upāsakassa ābhataṃ, idha cīvaradānanti ayameva viseso.
